title: Advance a partial transfer
prompt: Track a transfer of requested bytes. completed is the old count and reported is the new chunk length. Return the new count. Throw std::invalid_argument if the old count is too large or the chunk exceeds the remaining space.
signature: std::size_t advance(std::size_t completed, std::size_t reported, std::size_t requested)

tests.label: Partial chunk
tests.hint: Add the new chunk to the completed count.

tests.label: Finish exactly
tests.hint: Completion at the requested count is valid.

tests.label: No progress
tests.hint: A zero-sized chunk leaves the count unchanged.

tests.label: Invalid old state
tests.hint: Check the old count before subtracting it.

hints: Check the chunk against the remaining amount before addition.
explanation: This is the accounting rule used around partial reads or writes. It does not perform I/O; it gives a small, testable boundary for real I/O code.
chapterTitle: Performing Low-Level File and Device I/O
